name: Cross-account whole-container read fully removed by an explicit Deny (negative; deny)
note: S2-crossaccount-scoped-surface (B) Deny interaction: the Allow would be a cross-account whole-table read (table in 999999999999, subject 123456789012), but a same-policy unconditional Deny on dynamodb:Scan removes the capability (AWS explicit-Deny precedence). CROSS-ACCOUNT-DATA-READ must NOT survive in the authoritative table - a denied read is not a grant. Witnesses the negative and Deny cells.
